analysis_steps.goal: Compute Delta SFE and Delta f_H2 offsets

method.value: Delta SFE is the offset in Sigma_SFR from control spaxels matched in Sigma_H2, stellar mass, R/Re and O/H; Delta f_H2 is the offset in Sigma_H2 at fixed Sigma_star with matching in stellar mass, R/Re and O/H; controls from ALMaQUEST spaxels with normal SFR

evidence.quote: matched within 0.1 dex in $\Sigma_{\rm H_2}$, 0.1 dex in total stellar mass (of the host galaxy), 0.1 in $R/R_e$ and 0.1 dex in O/H

Specifically, $\Delta f_{\rm H_2}$ is computed as the offset of $\Sigma_{\rm H_2}$ at fixed $\Sigma_{\star}$, with additional spaxel matching in total stellar mass of the host galaxy (within 0.1 dex), $R/R_e$ (within 0.1) and O/H (within 0.1 dex).

claims.hypothesis: Central starbursts are driven mainly by elevated star formation efficiency rather than elevated gas fraction
claims.experiment: Compare Delta SFE and Delta f_H2 (offsets from the resolved Kennicutt-Schmidt relation and molecular gas main sequence) for the 12 central starbursts, as central averages, radial profiles and spaxel correlations
claims.result: Delta Sigma_SFR correlates more steeply, tightly and significantly with Delta SFE than with Delta f_H2 across 5278 spaxels
claims.finding: The primary driver of the central starburst is an elevated SFE

evidence.quote: we conclude that the primary driver of the central starburst is an elevated SFE

claims.hypothesis: Elevated gas fractions also contribute to the central starbursts
claims.experiment: Delta f_H2 profiles and central medians with fixed alpha_CO, and with alpha_CO lowered by a factor of two
claims.result: Some galaxies show enhanced gas fractions at face value, but most of these vanish for a lower alpha_CO
claims.finding: A gas fraction contribution is possible but depends on the choice of alpha_CO

evidence.quote: There may also be a contribution from enhanced gas fractions, but this conclusion is dependent on the choice of $\alpha_{CO}$.

claims.hypothesis: Starburst enhancement is accompanied by metal dilution consistent with metal-poor gas inflow
claims.experiment: Delta O/H profiles and Delta O/H vs Delta Sigma_SFR colour-coded by Delta SFE
claims.result: Two galaxies with the strongest Delta SFR and Delta SFE have suppressed central O/H; weak anti-correlation between Delta Sigma_SFR and Delta O/H across spaxels
claims.finding: Metal-poor gas injection in the strongest starburst regions has altered the ISM so that SFE is increased

evidence.quote: Taken together, our results indicate that, in regions with the strongest starbursts, metal poor gas injection has altered the ISM properties such that the SFE is increased.

claims.hypothesis: Central starbursts arise from both interactions and secular mechanisms
claims.experiment: Visual inspection of SDSS gri images of the 12 galaxies for merger features
claims.result: Three of 12 show merger features; 9 of 12 are undisturbed, with similar signatures in both
claims.finding: Both interactions and secular mechanisms contribute to central starbursts

evidence.quote: These observational signatures are found in both undisturbed (9/12 galaxies in our sample) and recently merged galaxies, indicating that both interactions and secular mechanisms contribute to central starbursts.

Although the sample is still small, the results suggest that metal-poor gas inflows from either merger-driven, or secular events can trigger starbursts.

referee_caveats_inferred: Constant alpha_CO of 4.3 drives Delta SFE and Delta f_H2 directly; only a qualitative factor-of-two test is given, so the SFE vs gas fraction conclusion rests on an untested systematic
The conclusion relies on a sample of 12 galaxies selected from within ALMaQUEST, itself not complete in mass or volume
The Delta SFE vs Delta Sigma_SFR correlation shares Sigma_SFR on both axes, so part of the correlation is built in by construction; no quantitative correlation coefficients are given
Overlapping sliding bins and spaxels oversampled relative to the 2.5 arcsec beam mean the 5278 spaxels are not independent

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Four ALMA projects, 12 galaxies used; roughly tens of GB of raw ALMA data, plus MaNGA DR15 PIPE3D cubes/VAC
reproducibility.score_reason: MaNGA inputs are public and the offset-metric recipe (control matching tolerances, cuts) is well described, but ALMA reduction is deferred to an unpublished paper and the main results are shown in figures with few numeric values.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA processing is unspecified and key results are graphical rather than numeric, so a faithful redo would require the unpublished ALMaQUEST reduction.
